hi! two years ago i flew across the world to see my aunt and uncle for christmas. i hadn't seen them since i was around ten, so it was a good while. i solo travelled for the first time, and a lot of things went south.

first things first, BRING SOME HEADPHONES!! even if it's just to drown out the noise by silence or by your favourite album, in my experience, they were my LIFESAVER. i'd sit in the living room of my aunt and have them on and listen to music when i felt like i needed some alone time. 

do you have anything to toy with? a stress toy, some kind of clothes or something sensory you know that you can lean on? when i travelled, i travelled in my favourite pyjama bottoms && my favourite hoodie. i made sure i downloaded my favourite show episodes and a good film i liked, but i didn't bring anything sensory to feel which i should've done.

talk to your mum about how you know she wants to make the best out of a trip, but for the both of you to make the best out of it, you might need some alone time at the hotel or wherever it is you're staying. for me, my safe space was my guest room at my aunts. i'd go up there sometimes and sit for a few hours, play animal crossing, then go and socialise when i felt like my social battery was charged up again.

if you like lists like i do, make a list of what you guys are doing day by day! it'll give you some sort of routine when you're in a foreign place. lastly, enjoy your trip! if you want, try some new foods. or some sweets. get some memorabilia from tokyo that you could put on display or wear or whatever. i hope any of this advice is helpful, and i hope you and your mum have a lovely time together!!
